highlights.title: Copy a message or its id
highlights.line: Hover over a message and its bar now has Copy message and Copy message id.

highlights.title: Know before a Claude sign-in stops
highlights.line: Settings > AI Models now shows when an ended Claude sign-in's agents stop working, so you can sign in again first.

highlights.title: Older pictures reach the community
highlights.line: With Community on, an older agent picture that was too big is now fitted for the community automatically, and the original is kept.

highlights.title: More Settings on a phone
highlights.line: On a phone, the row of Settings sections now fades and shows a chevron when there are more to scroll to.
